This 
 document outlines the maintenance procedures check listed P1 which must be 
 performed for steam drum every 3 years as indicated by Y3 in the above title 
 block .

The steam 
 drum separates the water from the steam and returns the water by way of the 
 down comers.

The first 
 draft initiated by eng. Adel Atia tested by eng. Abd El-Azim Abdin, and 
 revised by EDEPC quality control engineer Samir Abd El-Gelil , accepted by 
 general director eng. Yosry Abd Elmaqsod, approved by eng. Awad Fathy 
 head sector of Talkha Power Station, and 
certified by eng. Aly 
Mostafa Al Lethy: EDEPCo. of Inspection and Quality Control Head Sector.

A work permit must 
 be issued and the qualified staff should be carry the suitable safety category 
 .

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your safety helmet, 
 shoes, .. etc.

The HRSG are out of service 
 and depressurized the high pressure section.

Drain the high pressure 
 drum and put red tag on the feed water pumps.

The inlet dampers are 
 closed , locked mechanical.

Disconnect the power supply 
 for the damper actuators.

Complete maintenance tool 
 set.
Cleaning fluid, Rages.
Grinder and grinding wheel.
Remove front and rear manholes doors insulation.
Open front manhole door.
Remove old gasket.
Clean internal parts.

Inspect 
 the following parts and repare if needed.

Drum 
 doors for pits, cracks and damage.

Drum 
 internals for pits, cracks and damage.

Drum body 
 for pits, cracks and damage.

Check 
 water level glass and change if needed.

Reinstall 
 new gaskets.
Close drum manholes doors.

Reinstall 
 manholes doors insulation.

Introduction
This 
 document outlines the maintenance procedures check listed P1 which must be 
 performed for steam drum every 3 years as indicated by Y3 in the above title 
 block .
The steam 
 drum separates the water from the steam and returns the water by way of the 
 down comers.
The first 
 draft initiated by eng. Adel Atia tested by eng. Abd El-Azim Abdin, and 
 revised by EDEPC quality control engineer Samir Abd El-Gelil , accepted by 
 general director eng. Yosry Abd Elmaqsod, approved by eng. Awad Fathy 
 head sector of Talkha Power Station, and 
certified by eng. Aly 
Mostafa Al Lethy: EDEPCo. of Inspection and Quality Control Head Sector.

Safety Precautions
A work permit must 
 be issued and the qualified staff should be carry the suitable safety category 
 .
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, 
 shoes, .. etc.
The HRSG are out of service 
 and depressurized the high pressure section.
Drain the high pressure 
 drum and put red tag on the feed water pumps.
The inlet dampers are 
 closed , locked mechanical.
Disconnect the power supply 
 for the damper actuators.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool 
 set.
Cleaning fluid, Rages.
Grinder and grinding wheel.
Work to be carried out
Remove front and rear manholes doors insulation.
Open front manhole door.
Remove old gasket.
Clean internal parts.
Inspect 
 the following parts and repare if needed.
Drum 
 doors for pits, cracks and damage.
Drum 
 internals for pits, cracks and damage.
Drum body 
 for pits, cracks and damage.
Check 
 water level glass and change if needed.
Reinstall 
 new gaskets.
Close drum manholes doors.
Reinstall 
 manholes doors insulation.
